Name: Better Quality Increased Seeds - Christmas Crops
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses the Producer Framework Mod to increase the number of seeds produced by the seed maker when higher quality produce are used.

One additional seed is given for each quality level.

Regular: 1 - 3
Silver: 2 - 4
Gold: 3 - 5
Iridium: 4 - 6

This mod covers all produce from the 'Christmas Crops' mod that can be processed by the seed maker.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4993]Christmas Crops[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][PFM] Better Quality Increase Seeds Christmas Crops[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac.
[*] Due to PFM only permitting one active rule for each combo of input and machine, if any other PFM mods that alter the 'Christmas Crops' interactions with the seed maker are installed, only the first one loaded will function. This can be overridden, but the mod to be overridden must be specified by the overridding mod. As such, a compatibility patch will be required. Drop a post with a link to the other mod and I'll see about making a compatibility patch.
[/list]
